messages:
alex_k: Heads-up — hit a subtle kv-cache correctness issue when bringing up the new open-quant model with long contexts. Repro below, pretty small diff but diverges after ~8k tokens.

morgan: can you paste the minimal repro? which quant profile did you use?

alex_k: using `quant-perlayer-v2` + fp16 inference runtime. Ran a 10k token doc and compared outputs vs float32 baseline. baseline/quant match until token 8192, then token at 8193 differs and stays divergent.

jia_liu: ugh. do you have logs? maybe an eviction/rollover happened.

alex_k: logged snippets: \n```
INFO kv_cache_len=8192 current_index=8192
INFO apply_rope_phase layer=12 phase=-3.1415925
INFO emit_token idx=8192 token=1223
--- next token ---
INFO kv_cache_len=8193 current_index=8193
INFO apply_rope_phase layer=12 phase=3.1415926  # flipped sign
INFO emit_token idx=8193 token=1199  # baseline token=1223
```
(reproducer command below)

alex_k: repro: `./run_eval --model gptx-open-30b-quant --quant-profile quant-perlayer-v2 --context 10000 --seed 42 --compare-baseline ../baseline_fp32.out`

rohit_p: that phase flip at layer 12 smells like RoPE wraparound combined with reduced precision math. per-layer quant might be changing scale factors that interact with rotary embedding computation. did you check rotary implementation (relative vs absolute pos)?

morgan: also check whether we are truncating position indices when we compress kvs during eviction. if kv index becomes signed 16 somewhere it could wrap.

alex_k: good call. I inspected the runtime: when `kv_eviction=true` we compress indices into `uint16` for the cache map to save memory. That was fine for <=8192 but at 8193 if something casts to `int16` during a vectorized op it flips sign and makes the phase argument wrong.

eva_ops: this is alarming for Dedicated customers hitting long contexts. quick mitigation: set `kv_index_dtype=uint32` or cap context. Can we add a guard assert in runtime to catch index overflow? :eyes:

jia_liu: i added a test in the local harness: `tests/kv_index_overflow.py` that allocates `context=10000` and asserts no sign flips. CI results: `ci-bot`?

ci-bot: Automated test run: https://ci.redwood.dev/builds/87912 - kv_index_overflow.py FAILED on quant-perlayer-v2, PASS on baseline-fp32.

rohit_p: long term fix: don't downcast indices. Also revisit RoPE scaling path — quantization should preserve the rotary angle numerics (we might want to store a per-layer small FP16 scale for the sin/cos table).

alex_k: short-term patch pushed to runtime branch `fix/kv-idx-cast` — forces index arrays to 32-bit and adds an assert: `assert(kv_index >= 0)` before using as slice. Also added a Canary in `eng-ml/evals/long_context_smoke` that runs 12 models at contexts 12k/20k.

morgan: thanks. can we also add a small eval to compare top-5 tokens at the divergence point and alert if KL>0.1? would catch quality regressions, not just hard crashes.

alex_k: yes, added approximate KL check and a nightly job.

eva_ops: FYI ops/infra: rolling patch to Dedicated GPU pools that had `kv_index_dtype=auto` will be pinned to `uint32` for now. Monitoring alerts created. :white_check_mark:

jia_liu: re-run after patch shows alignment restored for quant-perlayer-v2 on that reproduce case. baseline vs quant now match token-by-token for 10k doc.

rohit_p: nice detective work. follow-ups: (1) add unit to ensure RoPE angle accumulation is stable under quant scaling, (2) add fuzz tests for index dtype casts in vectorized ops.

alex_k: noted. will open issues and assign. thanks all. :tada:
